# Module catalogue

<!-- Generated by `pnpm generate` from the registered modules. Do not edit by hand. -->

Every module available to `spawnforge/0.1` blueprints. Lengths are in torso lengths (multiples of
the blueprint's `scale`); angles are in degrees. Run `spawnforge describe-module <id>` or the
`describe_module` tool for the same facts as JSON.

## Blueprint fields

Every field outside the modules, generated from the schema. Fields with a default may be left out.

### `Top level`

| Field | Type | Range | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `format` | string |  |  | Format id and version |
| `name` | string |  | `"Unnamed creature"` |  |
| `seed` | integer | 0–4294967295 | `1` | Same blueprint and seed, same monster |
| `extends` | "biped" \| "hexapod" \| "quadruped" \| "serpent" |  |  | Body-plan preset to start from |
| `scale` | number | 0.05–20 | `1` | Torso length in metres; every other length is a multiple of it |
| `limbs` | list of object |  | `[]` | Legs and arms. Lists merge with the preset by id |
| `parts` | list of object |  | `[]` | Hard parts. Lists merge with the preset by id |

### `body.torso`

The main body. Its length is the blueprint `scale`.

| Field | Type | Range | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `radius` | number or list of number | 0.02–1 | `[0.14, 0.18, 0.16, 0.12]` | Radius from the neck end to the tail end, in torso lengths |
| `arch` | number | -0.5–0.5 | `0` | Upward bow of the spine, as a share of torso length; negative sags |
| `pitch` | number | -30–90 | `0` | Degrees the torso tilts nose-up: 0 is horizontal, about 75 for an upright biped |
| `crossSection` | "round" \| "tall" \| "wide" |  | `"round"` | Shape across the torso |
| `segments` | integer | 3–12 | `6` | Spine bones in the torso |

### `body.neck`

Joins the head to the front of the torso.

| Field | Type | Range | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `length` | number | 0–1.5 | `0.3` | Neck length in torso lengths; 0 for no neck |
| `radius` | number or list of number | 0.01–0.6 | `[0.07, 0.09]` | Radius from the head end to the torso end, in torso lengths |
| `pitch` | number | -60–90 | `20` | Degrees the neck rises above horizontal |
| `crossSection` | "round" \| "tall" \| "wide" |  | `"round"` | Shape across the neck |
| `segments` | integer | 1–8 | `3` | Bones in the neck |

### `body.head`

The head. `at` runs from the snout tip (0) to the back of the skull (1).

| Field | Type | Range | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `shape` | "round" \| "snout" \| "flat" \| "wedge" |  | `"round"` | Overall head shape |
| `length` | number | 0.05–1 | `0.28` | Snout tip to back of skull, in torso lengths |
| `radius` | number | 0.02–0.6 | `0.1` | Skull radius in torso lengths |
| `jaw` | boolean |  | `true` | A hinged lower jaw, needed for bite, roar and teeth |
| `pitch` | number | -60–60 | `0` | Degrees the snout points above horizontal |
| `crossSection` | "round" \| "tall" \| "wide" |  | `"round"` | Shape across the head |

### `body.tail`

Runs back from the torso. `at` runs from the root (0) to the tip (1).

| Field | Type | Range | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `length` | number | 0–4 | `0.6` | Tail length in torso lengths; 0 for no tail |
| `radius` | number or list of number | 0.005–0.6 | `[0.08, 0.012]` | Radius from the root to the tip, in torso lengths |
| `curl` | number | -360–360 | `0` | Total degrees the tail bends upward along its length; negative curls down |
| `curlStart` | number | 0–0.95 | `0` | Share of the tail that stays straight before the curl begins; 0.6 curls only the end |
| `crossSection` | "round" \| "tall" \| "wide" |  | `"round"` | Shape across the tail |
| `pitch` | number | -90–60 | `-10` | Degrees the tail root points above horizontal; negative droops |
| `segments` | integer | 2–24 | `8` | Bones in the tail |

### `limbs[]`

| Field | Type | Range | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | string |  |  | Unique id; mirrored copies get .L and .R |
| `role` | "leg" \| "arm" |  | `"leg"` | "leg" limbs carry the body; "arm" limbs are free |
| `attach` | object (below) |  | `{}` |  |
| `length` | number | 0.05–3 | `0.5` | Total limb length in torso lengths |
| `segments` | integer | 2–4 | `3` | Bones from hip or shoulder to ankle |
| `radius` | number or list of number | 0.005–0.5 | `[0.06, 0.03]` | Radius from root to tip, in torso lengths |
| `splay` | number | -30–90 | `0` | Degrees the limb swings out from under the body; about 50 for sprawlers |
| `lift` | number | 0–150 | `0` | Arms only: degrees the arm is raised forward from hanging; 90 holds it straight out (pincers) |
| `foot` | object or null |  | `{}` | Foot part at the limb tip (default { "type": "foot.claw" }), or null for none |
| `remove` | boolean |  |  | Delete an inherited limb with this id |

### `limbs[].attach`

| Field | Type | Range | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `on` | string |  | `"torso"` | Body section the limb grows from |
| `at` | number | 0–1 | `0.5` | Where along the section: 0 is the snout end, 1 the tail end |
| `side` | "both" \| "left" \| "right" \| "center" |  | `"both"` | "both" makes a mirrored pair with ids ending .L and .R |
| `angle` | number | 0–180 | `100` | Degrees around the section from the top: 90 is the side, 180 the belly |

### `parts[]`

| Field | Type | Range | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | string |  |  | Unique id; mirrored copies get .L and .R |
| `type` | "ear.pointed" \| "eye.basic" \| "horn.curved" \| "spikes.row" \| "teeth.row" |  |  | Part module id |
| `attach` | object (below) |  | `{}` |  |
| `params` | object |  | `{}` | The part module's parameters |
| `remove` | boolean |  |  | Delete an inherited part with this id |

### `parts[].attach`

| Field | Type | Range | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `on` | string |  |  | Body section (head, jaw, neck, torso, tail; spine runs neck to tail tip), limb id or part id |
| `at` | number | 0–1 |  | Where along it: snout-to-tail on sections, root-to-tip on limbs and parts |
| `from` | number | 0–1 |  | Start of a row |
| `to` | number | 0–1 |  | End of a row |
| `angle` | number | 0–180 |  | Degrees around the section from the top: 0 dorsal, 90 side, 180 belly |
| `side` | "both" \| "left" \| "right" \| "center" |  |  | Defaults to "both", or "center" when angle is 0 or 180 |

### `skin`

| Field | Type | Range | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `palette` | object |  | `{}` | Named colours. base, belly and accent always exist; add any others by name |
| `material` | "skin" \| "scales" \| "chitin" |  | `"skin"` | Base surface under the patterns |
| `layers` | list of object |  | `[{ "type": "countershade" }]` | Pattern stack, bottom first |

### `skin.layers[] (every layer)`

One pattern layer; its parameters sit beside `type`

| Field | Type | Range | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `type` | "countershade" \| "grime" \| "mottle" \| "scales" \| "spots" \| "stripes" |  |  | Pattern module id |
| `id` | string |  |  | Optional id; keys the layer random stream |
| `region` | "all" \| "back" \| "belly" \| "head" \| "torso" \| "limbs" \| "tail" |  | `"all"` | Where the layer shows |
| `strength` | number | 0–1 | `1` | Layer opacity |

### `motion`

| Field | Type | Range | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `temperament` | "calm" \| "stalking" \| "skittish" \| "aggressive" \| "lumbering" |  | `"calm"` | Sets pace, posture and idle behaviour |
| `gaits` | list of "slither" \| "tripod" \| "trot" \| "walk" or object |  |  | Gaits it may use; by default every gait that suits its legs |
| `actions` | list of "bite" \| "idle" \| "look" \| "roar" or object |  |  | Actions it can perform; by default every action its body allows |

## Body plans

### `biped`

Upright torso on two legs with two free arms; walks. Lean the torso forward and add a tail for a raptor.

Start a blueprint with "extends": "biped"; override preset limbs and parts by id.

Ids you can override: limb `leg`, limb `arm`, part `eyes`.

<details><summary>Preset</summary>

```json
{
  "scale": 0.7,
  "body": {
    "torso": {
      "radius": [0.13, 0.2, 0.18, 0.16],
      "arch": 0.04,
      "pitch": 82,
      "segments": 5,
      "crossSection": "wide"
    },
    "neck": { "length": 0.2, "radius": [0.065, 0.075], "pitch": 82, "segments": 2 },
    "head": { "shape": "round", "length": 0.3, "radius": 0.13, "jaw": true, "pitch": 0 },
    "tail": { "length": 0 }
  },
  "limbs": [
    {
      "id": "leg",
      "role": "leg",
      "attach": { "on": "torso", "at": 0.94, "side": "both", "angle": 130 },
      "length": 1.3,
      "segments": 2,
      "radius": [0.1, 0.05],
      "foot": { "type": "foot.claw", "toes": 3 }
    },
    {
      "id": "arm",
      "role": "arm",
      "attach": { "on": "torso", "at": 0.12, "side": "both", "angle": 92 },
      "length": 1.05,
      "segments": 2,
      "radius": [0.065, 0.04],
      "foot": { "type": "foot.claw", "toes": 4 }
    }
  ],
  "parts": [{ "id": "eyes", "type": "eye.basic", "attach": { "on": "head", "at": 0.3, "angle": 62 } }],
  "skin": {
    "palette": { "base": "#6f7a4a", "belly": "#c9c39a", "accent": "#2f3320" },
    "layers": [{ "type": "countershade" }]
  },
  "motion": { "temperament": "calm", "gaits": ["walk"] }
}
```

</details>

### `hexapod`

Six sprawled legs on a low, wide body with a chitin shell; runs a tripod gait.

Start a blueprint with "extends": "hexapod"; override preset limbs and parts by id.

Ids you can override: limb `frontleg`, limb `midleg`, limb `hindleg`, part `eyes`.

<details><summary>Preset</summary>

```json

  "scale": 0.8,
  "body": {
    "torso": {
      "radius": [0.1, 0.14, 0.085, 0.17, 0.15, 0.1],
      "pitch": 0,
      "segments": 8,
      "crossSection": "wide"
    },
    "neck": { "length": 0.06, "radius": [0.07, 0.08], "pitch": 0, "segments": 1 },
    "head": { "shape": "round", "length": 0.22, "radius": 0.09, "jaw": true, "pitch": -10 },
    "tail": { "length": 0 }
  },
  "limbs": [
    {
      "id": "frontleg",
      "role": "leg",
      "attach": { "on": "torso", "at": 0.1, "side": "both", "angle": 120 },
      "length": 0.6,
      "segments": 3,
      "radius": [0.035, 0.015],
      "splay": 55,
      "foot": { "type": "foot.claw", "toes": 1 }
    },
    {
      "id": "midleg",
      "role": "leg",
      "attach": { "on": "torso", "at": 0.22, "side": "both", "angle": 120 },
      "length": 0.62,
      "segments": 3,
      "radius": [0.035, 0.015],
      "splay": 60,
      "foot": { "type": "foot.claw", "toes": 1 }
    },
    {
      "id": "hindleg",
      "role": "leg",
      "attach": { "on": "torso", "at": 0.34, "side": "both", "angle": 120 },
      "length": 0.7,
      "segments": 3,
      "radius": [0.035, 0.015],
      "splay": 55,
```

### `quadruped`

Four legs under a horizontal torso, a raised neck and a tail; walks and trots.

Start a blueprint with "extends": "quadruped"; override preset limbs and parts by id.

Ids you can override: limb `foreleg`, limb `hindleg`, part `eyes`.

<details><summary>Preset</summary>

```json
{
  "scale": 1,
  "body": {
    "torso": { "radius": [0.14, 0.17, 0.16, 0.13], "arch": 0.08, "pitch": 0, "segments": 6 },
    "neck": { "length": 0.32, "radius": [0.07, 0.1], "pitch": 30, "segments": 3 },
    "head": { "shape": "snout", "length": 0.3, "radius": 0.1, "jaw": true, "pitch": -10 },
    "tail": { "length": 0.7, "radius": [0.07, 0.012], "pitch": -20, "curl": 10, "segments": 8 }
  },
  "limbs": [
    {
      "id": "foreleg",
      "role": "leg",
      "attach": { "on": "torso", "at": 0.12, "side": "both", "angle": 115 },
      "length": 0.55,
      "segments": 3,
      "radius": [0.06, 0.03],
      "foot": { "type": "foot.claw", "toes": 4 }
    },
    {
      "id": "hindleg",
      "role": "leg",
      "attach": { "on": "torso", "at": 0.88, "side": "both", "angle": 115 },
      "length": 0.6,
      "segments": 3,
      "radius": [0.07, 0.03],
      "foot": { "type": "foot.claw", "toes": 4 }
    }
  ],
  "parts": [{ "id": "eyes", "type": "eye.basic", "attach": { "on": "head", "at": 0.35, "angle": 55 } }],
  "skin": {
    "palette": { "base": "#7a6a50", "belly": "#d9cdb0", "accent": "#3b2e22" },
    "layers": [{ "type": "countershade" }]
  },
  "motion": { "temperament": "calm", "gaits": ["walk", "trot"] }
}
```

</details>

### `serpent`

Legless snake body with a long tail and scales; slithers with a wave down the spine.

Start a blueprint with "extends": "serpent"; override preset limbs and parts by id.

Ids you can override: part `eyes`.

<details><summary>Preset</summary>

```json
{
  "scale": 0.6,
  "body": {
    "torso": { "radius": [0.07, 0.085, 0.09, 0.085], "pitch": 0, "segments": 8 },
    "neck": { "length": 0.15, "radius": [0.065, 0.07], "pitch": 10, "segments": 2 },
    "head": { "shape": "wedge", "length": 0.2, "radius": 0.075, "jaw": true, "pitch": 0 },
    "tail": { "length": 2.2, "radius": [0.085, 0.01], "pitch": 0, "curl": 0, "segments": 16 }
  },
  "limbs": [],
  "parts": [
    {
      "id": "eyes",
      "type": "eye.basic",
      "attach": { "on": "head", "at": 0.35, "angle": 70 },
      "params": { "size": 0.016, "pupil": "slit" }
    }
  ],
  "skin": {
    "palette": { "base": "#4f6b3a", "belly": "#d8d0a0", "accent": "#24301a" },
    "material": "scales",
    "layers": [{ "type": "countershade" }, { "type": "scales", "size": 0.025 }]
  },
  "motion": { "temperament": "stalking", "gaits": ["slither"] }
}
```

</details>

## Parts

### `ear.pointed`

Leaf-shaped ear, upright or drooping; use side "both" for a pair.

Add to "parts" with "type": "ear.pointed"; parameters go in "params".

slot: `"surface"` · material: `"skin"` · defaultAttach: `{"on":"head","at":0.85,"angle":45}`

| Parameter | Type | Range | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `length` | number | 0.02–0.6 | `0.12` | Length in torso lengths |
| `width` | number | 0.01–0.25 | `0.05` | Widest half-width in torso lengths |
| `thickness` | number | 0.1–1 | `0.3` | Thickness as a share of the width: low is a flat leaf, 1 a round cone |
| `curve` | number | -120–120 | `15` | Degrees the ear bends; positive sweeps back toward the tail, negative forward |
| `lean` | number | -90–90 | `0` | Degrees the root tilts forward (+) or back (-) |
| `droop` | number | 0–1 | `0` | How much the ear flops outward and down, 0 upright to 1 hanging |
| `color` | string |  | `"base"` | Colour at the root: a palette name or a colour |
| `tipColor` | string |  | `"base"` | Colour at the tip |

```json
{
  "id": "ears",
  "type": "ear.pointed",
  "attach": { "on": "head", "at": 0.85, "angle": 45, "side": "both" },
  "params": { "length": 0.14, "width": 0.05 }
}
```

### `eye.basic`

Round eyeball with an iris and pupil that turns to look at targets and blinks.

Add to "parts" with "type": "eye.basic"; parameters go in "params".

slot: `"surface"` · material: `"eye"` · defaultAttach: `{"on":"head","at":0.4,"angle":60}`

| Parameter | Type | Range | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `size` | number | 0.005–0.2 | `0.022` | Eyeball radius in torso lengths |
| `pupil` | "round" \| "slit" \| "goat" |  | `"round"` | Pupil shape |
| `irisColor` | string |  | `"#c8a030"` | Iris colour: a palette name or a colour |
| `scleraColor` | string |  | `"#e8e2cc"` | Colour of the eyeball around the iris |
| `iris` | number | 0.2–1 | `0.7` | Iris size as a share of the visible eye |
| `bulge` | number | 0–1 | `0.5` | How far the eye stands out of the skin |

```json
{
  "id": "eyes",
  "type": "eye.basic",
  "attach": { "on": "head", "at": 0.4, "angle": 60, "side": "both" },
  "params": { "size": 0.02, "pupil": "slit" }
}
```

### `foot.claw`

Foot or hand of short toes, each tipped with a curved claw; set it as a limb's "foot".

Set as a limb's foot: { "foot": { "type": "foot.claw", ...params } }.

slot: `"foot"` · material: `"horn"` · defaultAttach: `{"on":"limb"}`

| Parameter | Type | Range | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `toes` | integer | 1–6 | `3` | Toes (or fingers) per foot |
| `toeLength` | number | 0.01–0.5 | `0.08` | Toe length in torso lengths |
| `spread` | number | 0–150 | `50` | Degrees between the outermost toes |
| `clawLength` | number | 0–0.3 | `0.035` | Claw length in torso lengths; 0 for none |
| `clawCurve` | number | 0–180 | `70` | Degrees each claw bends down |
| `clawWidth` | number | 0.2–3 | `1` | Claw thickness relative to the toe |
| `clawColor` | string |  | `"#2a221c"` | Claw colour: a palette name or a colour |

```json
{ "type": "foot.claw", "toes": 3, "clawLength": 0.05 }
```

### `horn.curved`

Tapered horn bent along an arc; use side "both" for a pair.

Add to "parts" with "type": "horn.curved"; parameters go in "params".

slot: `"surface"` · material: `"horn"` · defaultAttach: `{"on":"head","at":0.75,"angle":40}`

| Parameter | Type | Range | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `length` | number | 0.02–1 | `0.2` | Length in torso lengths |
| `width` | number | 0.005–0.3 | `0.035` | Base radius in torso lengths |
| `curve` | number | -540–540 | `45` | Total bend in degrees; positive sweeps back toward the tail, negative forward; past 360 it coils |
| `twist` | number | -720–720 | `0` | Spiral in degrees along the horn, like a ram |
| `lean` | number | -90–90 | `0` | Degrees the root tilts forward (+) or back (-) |
| `turn` | number | -180–180 | `0` | Degrees the bend turns sideways: 90 curves toward the midline (mandibles), -90 away from it |
| `ridges` | integer | 0–30 | `0` | Rings along the horn |
| `color` | string |  | `"#d4c6a2"` | Colour at the root: a palette name or a colour |
| `tipColor` | string |  | `"#3d3329"` | Colour at the tip |

```json
{
  "id": "horns",
  "type": "horn.curved",
  "attach": { "on": "head", "at": 0.75, "angle": 40, "side": "both" },
  "params": { "length": 0.25, "curve": 60 }
}
```

### `spikes.row`

A row of conical spikes between two points, e.g. down the spine at angle 0.

Add to "parts" with "type": "spikes.row"; parameters go in "params".

slot: `"row"` · material: `"bone"` · defaultAttach: `{"on":"torso","angle":0}`

| Parameter | Type | Range | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `count` | integer | 1–60 | `7` | Spikes in the row |
| `height` | number or list of number | 0.01–0.5 | `0.08` | Height in torso lengths, as one number or a profile along the row |
| `width` | number | 0.005–0.2 | `0.025` | Base radius in torso lengths |
| `curve` | number | -90–90 | `20` | Degrees each spike sweeps back toward the tail |
| `jitter` | number | 0–1 | `0` | Irregular heights and angles, for jagged rows |
| `color` | string |  | `"#ddd1b4"` | Colour at the root: a palette name or a colour |
| `tipColor` | string |  | `"#5e5040"` | Colour at the tip |

```json
{
  "id": "dorsal",
  "type": "spikes.row",
  "attach": { "on": "torso", "from": 0.05, "to": 0.95, "angle": 0 },
  "params": { "count": 9, "height": [0.08, 0.15, 0.06] }
}
```

### `teeth.row`

Teeth along the mouth line; the upper row moves with the head, the lower with the jaw.

Add to "parts" with "type": "teeth.row"; parameters go in "params".

slot: `"mouth"` · material: `"enamel"` · defaultAttach: `{"on":"head"}`

| Parameter | Type | Range | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `count` | integer | 1–40 | `10` | Teeth per row on each side |
| `length` | number | 0.005–0.2 | `0.025` | Tooth length in torso lengths |
| `fangs` | integer | 0–4 | `1` | Long fangs at the front of each row |
| `fangLength` | number | 0.01–0.4 | `0.06` | Fang length in torso lengths |
| `upper` | boolean |  | `true` | Teeth in the upper row |
| `lower` | boolean |  | `true` | Teeth in the lower row |
| `color` | string |  | `"#efe8d0"` | A palette name such as "accent", or a colour such as "#2a1e14" |

```json
{ "id": "teeth", "type": "teeth.row", "params": { "count": 12, "fangs": 1 } }
```

## Patterns

### `countershade`

Paler belly blending into a darker back, as on most animals.

Add to skin.layers as { "type": "countershade", ...params }; every layer also takes "region" and "strength".

| Parameter | Type | Range | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `color` | string |  | `"belly"` | Belly colour: a palette name or a colour |
| `height` | number | -1–1 | `-0.1` | Where the blend sits: -1 belly, 0 flank, 1 back |
| `softness` | number | 0.01–1 | `0.35` | Width of the blend |

```json
{ "type": "countershade", "strength": 0.6 }
```

### `grime`

Dirt gathered in creases, on the feet and low on the body; adds roughness.

Add to skin.layers as { "type": "grime", ...params }; every layer also takes "region" and "strength".

| Parameter | Type | Range | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `color` | string |  | `"#5c4c3a"` | A palette name such as "accent", or a colour such as "#2a1e14" |
| `amount` | number | 0–1 | `0.5` | Overall strength |
| `creases` | number | 0–1 | `0.7` | Dirt in creases and joints |
| `feet` | number | 0–1 | `0.6` | Dirt rising from the ground up the legs |

```json
{ "type": "grime", "amount": 0.4 }
```

### `mottle`

Soft, cloudy blotches of a second colour that break up the outline.

Add to skin.layers as { "type": "mottle", ...params }; every layer also takes "region" and "strength".

| Parameter | Type | Range | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `color` | string |  | `"accent"` | A palette name such as "accent", or a colour such as "#2a1e14" |
| `scale` | number | 0.01–1 | `0.15` | Blotch size in torso lengths |
| `contrast` | number | 0–1 | `0.5` | How sharp the blotch edges are |
| `coverage` | number | 0–1 | `0.5` | Share of the skin covered |

```json
{ "type": "mottle", "color": "accent", "scale": 0.2, "coverage": 0.4 }
```

### `scales`

Overlapping scales as bump and darker gaps between them.

Add to skin.layers as { "type": "scales", ...params }; every layer also takes "region" and "strength".

| Parameter | Type | Range | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `size` | number | 0.005–0.2 | `0.02` | Scale size in torso lengths |
| `bump` | number | 0–1 | `0.4` | Depth of the scale relief |
| `gapColor` | string |  | `"accent"` | Colour in the gaps between scales: a palette name or a colour |
| `gap` | number | 0–1 | `0.3` | How dark and wide the gaps are |

```json
{ "type": "scales", "size": 0.02, "bump": 0.4 }
```

### `spots`

Scattered round spots, from leopard rosettes to sparse blotches.

Add to skin.layers as { "type": "spots", ...params }; every layer also takes "region" and "strength".

| Parameter | Type | Range | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `color` | string |  | `"accent"` | A palette name such as "accent", or a colour such as "#2a1e14" |
| `size` | number | 0.005–0.5 | `0.05` | Spot radius in torso lengths |
| `density` | number | 0–1 | `0.5` | Share of possible spots that appear |
| `jitter` | number | 0–1 | `0.8` | Irregularity of placement and size |
| `ring` | number | 0–1 | `0` | Hollow the spots into rings (rosettes) |

```json
{ "type": "spots", "color": "accent", "size": 0.04, "density": 0.6 }
```

### `stripes`

Bands running across the spine (or along it), with optional wobble.

Add to skin.layers as { "type": "stripes", ...params }; every layer also takes "region" and "strength".

| Parameter | Type | Range | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `color` | string |  | `"accent"` | A palette name such as "accent", or a colour such as "#2a1e14" |
| `count` | number | 1–64 | `10` | Stripes from snout to tail tip |
| `width` | number | 0.05–0.95 | `0.35` | Stripe width as a share of the spacing |
| `jitter` | number | 0–1 | `0.3` | Wobble and irregularity |
| `direction` | "across" \| "along" |  | `"across"` | "across" the spine like a tiger, or "along" it |
| `fade` | number | 0–1 | `0.6` | How much stripes fade toward the belly |

```json
{ "type": "stripes", "color": "accent", "count": 12, "region": "back", "jitter": 0.4 }
```

## Gaits

### `slither`

Legless travelling wave down the spine; each segment follows the path of the one ahead.

List in motion.gaits as "slither", or { "type": "slither", ...params }.

legPairs: `[0]` · duty: `1` · froude: `[0,3]` · wave: `0`

| Parameter | Type | Range | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `amplitude` | number | 0–0.6 | `0.18` | Sideways swing as a share of body length |
| `waves` | number | 0.5–4 | `1.5` | Wavelengths along the body |

```json
{ "motion": { "gaits": ["slither"] } }
```

### `tripod`

Six-legged insect gait: two alternating tripods of feet.

List in motion.gaits as "tripod", or { "type": "tripod", ...params }.

legPairs: `[3]` · duty: `0.5` · froude: `[0.1,3]` · wave: `0.5`

| Parameter | Type | Range | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `duty` | number | 0.3–0.8 |  | Share of the cycle each foot is planted |
| `stepHeight` | number | 0–1 | `0.25` | Foot lift as a share of hip height |
| `stride` | number | 0.2–2 | `1` | Stride length multiplier |

```json
{ "motion": { "gaits": ["tripod"] } }
```

### `trot`

Faster four-legged gait: diagonal feet move together.

List in motion.gaits as "trot", or { "type": "trot", ...params }.

legPairs: `[2]` · duty: `0.5` · froude: `[0.4,2.5]` · wave: `0.5`

| Parameter | Type | Range | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `duty` | number | 0.3–0.7 |  | Share of the cycle each foot is planted |
| `stepHeight` | number | 0–1 | `0.2` | Foot lift as a share of hip height |
| `stride` | number | 0.2–2 | `1` | Stride length multiplier |

```json
{ "motion": { "gaits": ["trot"] } }
```

### `walk`

Slow gait for any leg count: feet lift one after another, back to front.

List in motion.gaits as "walk", or { "type": "walk", ...params }.

legPairs: `"any"` · duty: `0.7` · froude: `[0,0.5]` · wave: `[{"pairs":1,"wave":0.5},{"pairs":2,"wave":0.25},{"pairs":3,"wave":0.3333333333333333}]`

| Parameter | Type | Range | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `duty` | number | 0.4–0.95 |  | Share of the cycle each foot is planted; defaults by leg count |
| `stepHeight` | number | 0–1 | `0.15` | Foot lift as a share of hip height |
| `stride` | number | 0.2–2 | `1` | Stride length multiplier |

```json
{ "motion": { "gaits": ["walk"] } }
```

## Actions

### `bite`

Lunges the head at a target and snaps the jaw shut; fires a bite-contact event.

List in motion.actions as "bite", or { "type": "bite", ...params }.

needs: `["jaw"]`

| Parameter | Type | Range | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `reach` | number | 0–1 | `0.7` | How far the neck may stretch, as a share of its reach |
| `speed` | number | 0.25–4 | `1` | Speed multiplier |

```json
{ "motion": { "actions": ["bite"] } }
```

### `idle`

Breathing, weight shifts, glances, tail swish and blinks while standing.

List in motion.actions as "idle", or { "type": "idle", ...params }.

needs: `[]`

| Parameter | Type | Range | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `breath` | number | 0–1 | `0.5` | Breathing depth |
| `fidget` | number | 0–1 | `0.5` | How often it shifts and looks around |

```json
{ "motion": { "actions": ["idle"] } }
```

### `look`

Turns eyes, head and neck toward a target within limits.

List in motion.actions as "look", or { "type": "look", ...params }.

needs: `["head"]`

| Parameter | Type | Range | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `speed` | number | 0.25–4 | `1` | Speed multiplier |
| `range` | number | 10–180 | `100` | Degrees the head may turn from straight ahead |

```json
{ "motion": { "actions": ["look"] } }
```

### `roar`

Raises the head and opens the jaw wide; fires a roar-peak event.

List in motion.actions as "roar", or { "type": "roar", ...params }.

needs: `["jaw"]`

| Parameter | Type | Range | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `duration` | number | 0.5–6 | `2` | Seconds for a creature with 1 m hips; scales with size |
| `intensity` | number | 0–1 | `0.8` | How wide the jaw opens and how far the head rises |

```json
{ "motion": { "actions": ["roar"] } }
```

## Themes

### `demon`

Horned fiends and hellhounds: heavy shoulders, big curled or swept horns, fangs, spine rows, goat or slit pupils, blood reds and soot blacks.

Generate creatures with it: spawnforge generate --theme demon --seed 1 (MCP: generate { "theme": "demon", "seed": 1 }).

bodyPlans: `{"biped":3,"quadruped":2}` · parts: `[{"chance":1,"id":"eyes"},{"chance":1,"id":"teeth","type":"teeth.row"},{"chance":0.8,"id":"horns","type":"horn.curved"},{"chance":0.5,"id":"spines","type":"spikes.row","plans":["quadruped"]},{"chance":0.4,"id":"ears","type":"ear.pointed"}]` · materials: `{"skin":3,"scales":1}` · temperaments: `{"aggressive":4,"stalking":2}`

### `insect`

Six-legged beetles and ants: glossy chitin, a thorax and abdomen with a narrow waist, thin legs, horns or pincers, dark or warning colours.

Generate creatures with it: spawnforge generate --theme insect --seed 1 (MCP: generate { "theme": "insect", "seed": 1 }).

bodyPlans: `{"hexapod":1}` · parts: `[{"chance":1,"id":"eyes"},{"chance":0.4,"id":"horn","type":"horn.curved"},{"chance":0.35,"id":"pincers","type":"horn.curved"}]` · materials: `{"chitin":1}` · temperaments: `{"skittish":3,"aggressive":2,"calm":1}`

### `reptile`

Scaled lizards, raptors and snakes: low sprawling bodies, long tails, wedge or snout heads, slit pupils, greens and browns.

Generate creatures with it: spawnforge generate --theme reptile --seed 1 (MCP: generate { "theme": "reptile", "seed": 1 }).

bodyPlans: `{"quadruped":5,"biped":2,"serpent":3}` · parts: `[{"chance":1,"id":"eyes"},{"chance":0.8,"id":"teeth","type":"teeth.row","plans":["quadruped","biped"]},{"chance":0.7,"id":"fangs","type":"teeth.row","plans":["serpent"]},{"chance":0.45,"id":"dorsal","type":"spikes.row","plans":["quadruped","biped"]},{"chance":0.25,"id":"brow","type":"horn.curved","plans":["quadruped"]}]` · materials: `{"scales":1}` · temperaments: `{"stalking":3,"calm":1,"aggressive":2}`
